```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = FALSE,
	message = FALSE,
	warning = FALSE

rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE))
gc()

library(ggplot2)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(dplyr)

```

## 1. Análisis descriptivo

```{r}

data <- colon

# La base original tiene una observacion por cada paciente donde etype = 1 (recurrencia) y otra donde etype = 2 (muerte).

data <- data %>% 
  filter(etype == 2) %>% # tipo de evento: muerte (no nos interesa la recurrencia del paciente)
  mutate(
    sex = factor(sex, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("female", "male")), # Factores a todas las categorias
    obstruct = factor(obstruct, levels = c(0,1)),
    perfor = factor(perfor, levels = c(0,1)),
    adhere = factor(adhere, levels = c(0,1)),
    differ = factor(differ, levels = c(1,2,3), labels = c("well", "moderate", "poor")),
    extent = factor(extent, levels = c(1,2,3,4), labels = c("submucosa", "muscle", "serosa", "contiguous structures")),
    surg = factor(surg, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("short", "long")),
    node4 = factor(node4, levels = c(0,1))
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(-study, -etype)

```





### 4. Ajuste de un modelo de Cox.



```{r}

data_ref <- data %>% mutate(
    rx = recode(rx, "Obs" = "Obs/Lev", "Lev" = "Obs/Lev") 
  ) %>% na.omit() 

data <- na.omit(data)

# Base de datos refinada (union de dos grupos de rx, ua que uno de ellos no era singificante

# Modelo con todas las covariables

mod_og <- coxph(Surv(time, status == 1) ~ rx + sex + age + obstruct + perfor + adhere + nodes + differ + extent + surg + node4, data = data)

kable(
  (summary(mod_og))$coefficients,
  digits = 4,
  caption = "Coeficientes del modelo con todas las covariables"
)
                
mod <- coxph(Surv(time, status == 1) ~ rx + adhere + nodes + surg, data = data_ref)
summary(mod)


```

### Análisis residual

```{r}

# Cox - Snell 
res_mart = residuals(mod,type='martingale')
res_cs = (data_ref$status == 1) - res_mart
data_ref$res_cs = res_cs

# KM using the Cox-Snell residuals as the times
fit_cs = survfit(Surv(res_cs, status == 1) ~ 1, data = data_ref)

# Plot cumulative hazard
df = data.frame(x=fit_cs$time,y=-log(fit_cs$surv))

ggplot(data=df,aes(x=x,y=y))+
  geom_line(col='darkgrey')+
  geom_point(size=.5)+
  labs(x="Cox-Snell residuals",y=expression(hat(H[t])))+
  geom_abline(intercept=0,slope=1,col="red")

# Martingala

# Martingale residuals vs continuous variables
data_ref$res_mart = res_mart

ggplot(data=data_ref,aes(x=nodes,y=res_mart))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = T, span = 0.75)+
  labs(x='Nodes',y='Martingale residuals')


# Devianza

res_dev = residuals(mod,type='deviance')
data_ref$res_dev = res_dev

ggplot(data=data_ref,aes(x=id,y=res_dev))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_hline(yintercept=0,col='red')+
  labs(x="",y="Deviance residuals")

# Delta-betas
res_dbs = residuals(mod, type = "dfbetas")
res_db = residuals(mod, type = "dfbeta")

# number of observations (n) and covariates (k)
n = nrow(data_ref)
k = 5
id = rep(1:n, k)

vars = c(rep('rxLev+5FU',n),rep('adhere1',n),rep('nodes',n),
         rep('nodes^2',n),rep('surglong',n))

val_std = c(res_dbs[,1],res_dbs[,2],res_dbs[,3],
            res_dbs[,4], res_dbs[,5])

val = c(res_db[,1],res_db[,2],res_db[,3],
        res_db[,4], res_db[,5])

db_df=data.frame(x=id,y_std=val_std,y=val,name=vars)

ggplot(data=db_df,aes(x=x,y=y_std,col=name))+
  geom_line()+
  labs(x='',y=expression(Delta[i]*beta[j]),
       color = "Covariate")

# Likelihood displacement
LD = numeric(n)
res_u = residuals(mod,type='score')
var_beta = mod$var

for(i in 1:n){
  LD[i]=t(res_u[i,])%*%var_beta%*%res_u[i,]
}

id = c(1:n)
LD_df = data.frame(x=id,y=LD)

ggplot(data=LD_df,aes(x=id,y=y))+
  geom_point()+
  labs(x="",y=expression(LD[i]))

View(LD_df %>% filter(y>.05))

cox.zph(mod)

View(db_df %>% filter(abs(y_std)>.15))
```
